Shatterforge · phase 1

    
A 12-storey office tower at real scale

    
Every wall, slab, column and stair is a real-size brick: storeys are 3.75 m, doors 0.875 × 2.125 m, corridors 1.75 m, steps 0.25 m. Walk in through the lobby, take the stair in the core, and knock holes in it. What falls off is simulated on the GPU as rigid pieces.

    

      
Mouse
look (click the view first)

      
W A S D
walk · Shift to run · Space to jump

      
F
fly mode on/off · Q / E down / up while flying

      
V
engineer's view: load against strength as colour, and the building's sag drawn larger

      
Click
blast at the crosshair

      
1 2 3
blast radius 0.4 / 0.7 / 1.2 m

      
4
fire a steel ball instead (it hits the walls for real)

      
Esc
menu: level, reset, graphics and physics settings, tools

      
R R
reset the level (R twice)

      
K
run the benchmark (reloads the page, then reports)
